title: ObjectMaskOut — one row of the object_mask receipt (the receipt the pod PUTs to put_url carries one row per requested picture in `items`)
description: One picture's NAMED outcome for the noun phrase asked of it. `found`: the object was cut — the RGBA PNG went to the item's cut_url (and the grey mask PNG to mask_url when given); `w`/`h` = the size of the picture those files and the fractions are of (the source after exif_transpose, transparency composited on white, and the 2048 long-side cap); `bbox` = the mask's bounding box [x, y, w, h] as fractions of that picture. `none`: no object of that phrase was found — a normal answer, `reasons` names why, nothing was PUT. `unreadable`: the source bytes are not a picture, nothing was PUT. The receipt itself is {model, model_sha256, torch, torchvision, transformers, generation, items: [row, …], timings: {model_s, wall_s}}, the screen_quad receipt's envelope with these rows.

bbox.description: found only: [x, y, w, h], the mask's bounding box as fractions of the picture, each in [0, 1]
